engine.notes: Phoenix's working improv rooms are in the East Valley, in Mesa and Gilbert, rather than in Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe or Glendale; The Torch Theatre's site could not be read by the fetcher, so Phoenix's long-form theater is absent from this first pass and should be checked by hand.

entries.name: Neighborhood Comedy Theatre
entries.summary: A downtown Mesa improv theater at 214 W Main Street staging more than 300 all-ages shows a year, with a six-level class program through the Harold and musical improv, a coached Saturday jam and a pay-what-you-can Friday jam.
entries.schedule: Shows Thu 7pm, Fri 7:30pm, Sat 7:30 and 9:30pm; six-week sessions start about every nine weeks
signals: Levels One-Six including the Harold and musical improv
Saturday coached jam and Friday jam
entries.reasons: Its own theater, shows three nights a week, a six-level ladder and two weekly jams with a current calendar; founding year and press are not stated.

entries.name: JesterZ Improv Comedy
entries.summary: The East Valley's clean short-form theater, running since 2001 and now at 228 N Gilbert Road, with two shows every Friday and Saturday night and a four-level adult program from Beginning Improv to Rising Stars performance prep.
entries.schedule: Shows Fri and Sat 6:30 and 8:30pm; adult classes started September 22-23, 2026
entries.reasons: A quarter century of weekend shows in its own venue and a four-level path with current dates; family short form only.
